description: This file defines API endpoints for managing roles in a web application. It includes functions for listing roles, retrieving a specific role by ID, and creating new roles. The endpoints interact with a Supabase backend and utilize FastAPI to define the routes and handle HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a role object with fields like id, code, name, and summary.

classes.name: RoleIn
classes.description: Pydantic model used for creating a new role, containing fields such as code, name, and optional summary.

methods.name: list_roles( authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None, description="Optional: Bearer <Supabase JWT> for personalized RLS; falls back to anon read"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all roles, with optional authorization for personalized data.

methods.name: get_role( role_id: int, authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None, description="Optional: Bearer <Supabase JWT>; falls back to anon read"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific role by its ID.

methods.name: create_role( payload: RoleIn, authorization: str = Header(..., description="Bearer <Supabase JWT>"), _: AuthUser = Depends(AdminGuard()), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new role; restricted to admin users.

ctags.name: create_role
ctags.signature: ( payload: RoleIn, authorization: str = Header(..., description="Bearer <Supabase JWT>"), _: AuthUser = Depends(AdminGuard()), )

ctags.name: get_role
ctags.signature: ( role_id: int, authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None, description="Optional: Bearer <Supabase JWT>; falls back to anon read"), )

ctags.name: list_roles
ctags.signature: ( authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None, description="Optional: Bearer <Supabase JWT> for personalized RLS; falls back to anon read"), )
